text:
maya: Heads-up — I opened an emergency docs PR to add the outage note + quick workaround for the streaming bug. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123

simon: saw it, thanks. do we have the status page link to point customers to?

maya: yes — https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026. also added a short note about the degraded kb cache behavior.

chun: can we include a tiny SDK example for the workaround? customers keep asking for quick copy/paste.

maya: good call. added a short Python snippet in the PR, but it's a bit rough — open to suggestions.

elaine: here's a minimal JS snippet that might be clearer, propose adding both: 

```js
// temporary: use response_mode=sync to avoid streaming flakes
const resp = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'rw-large-v1',
  input: 'Summarize the incident',
  response_mode: 'sync'
});
console.log(resp.output_text);
```

simon: nice. Can we also add an inline curl example for CLI folks?

maya: added this in a follow-up commit: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1","input":"Status summary","response_mode":"sync"}'
```

dev-docs-bot: Preview built: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/5123 — CI green except for one lint warning in TOC.

chun: who can review/approve quickly? need to merge before next rollout at 09:00 PT.

elaine: I can take a pass on copy. @simon can you double-check SDK snippets for accuracy?

simon: on it. small nit: change `response_mode=sync` -> `response_mode: 'sync'` in the Python example to be consistent. Also add note that this is temporary and may increase latency.

maya: done, added the consistency change and a line about latency impact. also added a status page link in the header.

deploy-bot: Canary docs publish scheduled at 08:40 PT — will auto-publish once merged.

chun: LGTM from infra side. only missing formal approval from product/security for wording about KMS usage.

maya: pinged @elaine and @simon for final thumbs.

elaine: approved. small grammar fix committed. :white_check_mark:

simon: approved. :+1:

maya: merging now. thanks everyone — will follow up with a short postmortem blurb for the incident page.

deploy-bot: Docs site updated at 08:45 PT — live version: https://docs.redwood.ai/platform/known-issues#incident-2026

maya: added a short known-issues bullet and a workaround section in the incident doc. leaving this thread open for any late corrections.

simon: one more tiny request later — can we add a cross-link to the SDK examples page so customers see extended samples? I'll open a non-emergency PR for that.

maya: perfect. closing this loop for the emergency update. :heart:
